dataset.name: FDIC bank financial statements — all reported quarters, 2000–2026Q2
dataset.description: Institution-quarter observations for the validated 500-bank cohort selected in 2026Q2. All available quarterly records from 2000Q1 through 2026Q2 and all native fields are retained; this is not the complete historical universe of every insured bank. Retained table: 51,453 source rows and 2,379 columns.
dataset.units: Source-native, column-specific units; retained official dictionaries and row unit fields govern interpretation.
dataset.notes:
Fixed 2026Q2 cohort, not historical top-500 or failure-inclusive population. Native quarterly and YTD fields are separate. Current vintage may contain revisions. API also contains noninsured NC records, explicitly excluded.
Largest 500 institutions at 2026-06-30 in insured bank classes N,NM,SM,SB,SI,SL,SA,OI. 51,453 rows; all 2,378 documented native fields explicitly requested. Latest financials index risview_20261116221646.
Source values and disclosure flags are unchanged. Retrieval time does not establish historical public availability.

coverage.identity_rule: CERT identifies insured institution; ID identifies source record; RSSDHCR identifies regulatory parent and must not replace CERT.

columns_complete.description:
The legal title or name of the institution._x000D_
Note: If you are having trouble finding an FDIC-Insured Institution: Type only part of the name. By typing a part of the name -- for example, type NET instead of NET.B@NK -- you can list all institutions that have net anywhere in their name. Then, you can look at the list and select the bank or thrift you are seeking.
